jobs.description:
Responsibilities

H.W. Kaufman Group is building an AI Value Engineering capability inside Information Technology to engineer measurable business value across the enterprise. The AI Value Engineering team operates at the intersection of application development, RPA, data, business operations, and AI-enabled delivery. Its charter is to deliver high-impact solutions across quick-strike and deep-dive engagements, partner closely with business stakeholders, transition proven solutions to sustaining teams, and stop initiatives quickly when they are not proving value. The team is measured on portfolio impact, successful handoffs, quantified business value, disciplined focus, and the ability to avoid becoming a maintenance or production-support function.

This role is for a hands-on, AI-enabled developer who can move across applications, automation, data, and business operations to identify high-impact opportunities, build working solutions, prove their work, and transition responsibly to sustaining teams.

We are looking for developers for whom building software is more than a job. Strong candidates are resourceful, curious, disciplined, and energized by solving problems. They have opinions shaped by experience, reading, experimentation, and exposure to good engineering practices. They understand that AI changes the speed of software delivery, but not the need for judgment, craftsmanship, business understanding, and accountability.

This role is best suited for a T-shaped or comb-shaped technologist: broad enough to wire together platforms, data, APIs, automations, and user workflows; deep enough to make sound technical decisions and avoid fragile solutions.

What Success Looks Like

  • Take a loosely defined business problem, clarify the value hypothesis, and produce a working demonstration quickly
  • Know when an AI agent’s recommendation is plausible, risky, over-engineered, or misaligned with enterprise supportability
  • Move comfortably between front-end, back-end, integration, data, workflow automation, and platform configuration
  • Actively look for simpler, faster, more supportable paths rather than merely implementing the first technical answer
  • Produce solutions that can be handed off cleanly; you do not create hidden dependencies on yourself
  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

Responsibilities

  • Deliver quick-strike solutions in days or weeks where business value is clear and the path is known
  • Contribute to deeper exploratory engagements over one to three months where the solution is uncertain, but the potential value is high
  • Build prototypes, automations, integrations, data-driven workflows, and application features across Salesforce, MuleSoft, .NET, RPA, AI/ML tooling, and related enterprise platforms
  • Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, or similar agents to accelerate delivery while validating architectural fit, maintainability, security, and operational risk
  • Work directly with underwriting, claims, operations, and IT stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, value drivers, and practical adoption constraints
  • Translate business problems into working software, measurable experiments, and clear handoff packages
  • Document architecture, configuration, dependencies, known limitations, prompts, runbooks, and operational considerations for the receiving team
  • Recommend pivoting or stopping work when an initiative is not proving valuable, without treating that as failure
  • Shadow and learn business workflows so solutions are grounded in how work gets done

Qualifications

  • Professional software development experience in enterprise environments with 5+ years of experience
  • Full-stack capability across application development, integrations, APIs, data access, workflow automation, and user-facing delivery
  • Experience with at least several of the following: Salesforce, MuleSoft, .NET/C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, REST APIs, RPA/workflow tools, cloud services, CI/CD, or enterprise data platforms
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools or a demonstrated ability to adopt them quickly and responsibly
  • Strong debugging, problem decomposition, and self-directed learning skills
  • Ability to evaluate code quality, maintainability, patterns, security implications, and operational fit
  • Ability to write clear technical documentation and conduct knowledge transfer with receiving teams
  • Comfort working in timeboxed engagements with defined outcomes, checkpoints, and handoff expectations
  • Experience in insurance, underwriting, brokerage, claims, or other workflow-heavy business domains is a plus
  • Exposure to enterprise architecture patterns, design patterns, domain modeling, relational database design, integration patterns, or similar engineering disciplines
  • Experience building automations or AI-enabled solutions that combine applications, data, documents, and human review workflows
  • Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic development workflows, or AI governance practices
  • Ability to operate inside appropriate enterprise guardrails while still challenging assumptions and finding better approaches

Complementary Strengths

Because this team is intentionally built from generalists who can go deep, we value candidates who bring complementary strengths that broaden the team’s overall capability. Experience in any of the following areas is a plus, but not required:

  • Information security — secure development practices, identity and access management, data protection, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, secure API design, or practical experience partnering with security teams
  • Azure and cloud services — Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Azure DevOps, or similar cloud-native services
  • Infrastructure as Code / DevOps — Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, deployment automation, observability, or release governance
  • Enterprise integration — API gateways, MuleSoft, event-driven integration, message queues, service orchestration, or integration monitoring
  • AI governance and operationalization — prompt/version management, LLM evaluation, data leakage prevention, human-in-the-loop review, auditability, monitoring, or safe deployment of AI-assisted workflows

With thousands of dedicated professionals across an extensive network of over 60 offices around the world, we lead by offering innovative solutions that are at the forefront of the industry. jobs.title: Managing Director for Finance and Operations
jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote - United States, United Kingdom, or Kenya Reports to: Chief Executive OfficerType of Role: Full-Time, IndefiniteAbout Village CapitalVillage Capital, is a US domiciled 501(c)3 that delivers entrepreneur support programs and manages blended pools of investment capital.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote - United States, United Kingdom, or Kenya

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Type of Role: Full-Time, Indefinite

About Village Capital

Village Capital, is a US domiciled 501(c)3 that delivers entrepreneur support programs and manages blended pools of investment capital. Known for its innovative approaches to supporting founders building solutions to social, economic, and environmental challenges, Village Capital unlocks social and financial capital for early-stage companies to maximize business and impact growth.

Since 2009, Village Capital has supported over 2,000 startups that have raised over $9 billion in follow on investment capital.

Role Overview

The Managing Director for Finance and Operations will oversee the finance and operations department of Village Capital, ensuring its financial health, compliance with regulations, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate is a multi-disciplinary leader who is both innovative and detail-oriented and excels at balancing strategic financial management with hands-on operations oversight. In coordination with the CEO and the Managing Director for Impact Investments, this role will be tasked with driving forward Village Capital’s financial strategy and operational model.

Experience in investment is essential to effectively integrate Village Capital’s revenue model, historically reliant on restrictive grant funding, with its ‘fit for purpose’ investment strategy. Village Capital is a nonprofit impact investor; therefore as an intermediary, the business model is dependent on successful delivery, and management, of blended finance.

The Managing Director for Finance and Operations should possess expertise in investment management: familiarity with fund administration, investment facilities, and accounting practices, as well as a knowledge of blended finance, and willingness to innovate on how to integrate Village Capital’s ongoing investment strategy within the organization’s accounting and operations strategy. Global asset management understanding is key, including ability to manage multi-currency transactions, underwrite and recognize debt and alternative investments, and accompanying accounting and financial modeling skills.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Managing Director for Finance and Operations will play a critical role in aligning financial and operational strategies with Village Capital’s goals.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership

  • Financial Management, Reporting, and Compliance
    • Build the strategy for updating and implementing automated systems and processes to collect, analyze, and report financial data accurately and timely.
    • Oversee the preparation of monthly and annual financial statements, dashboards, as well as forward-looking projections to inform the CEO, senior management, and board of directors’ decision making.
    • Manage investment and grant funding pipeline data collection; track financial performance, and ensure compliance with financial reporting requirements.
  • Budgeting, Audit, and Tax Compliance
    • Manage year-end close processes, annual budgeting, and financial planning, including board approval and variance analysis.
    • Oversee annual audits and tax filings (e.g., Form 990), including program-specific audits, ensuring timely completion with minimal findings.
  • Cash, Asset, and Grant Management
    • Develop and operate cash strategy: optimize the cash runway with efficient management of restricted and temporarily restricted assets and free cash; meet board requirements for cash and unrestricted net assets reserves.
    • Oversee the strategy and administration of fiscal sponsorships, re-grants, and other pass-through funds.
    • Develop updated product and service financial model, pricing, and budgeting in line with business model forward strategy.
  • Impact Investments Financial Management and Strategic Support
    • Build and oversee a fully-integrated back office to support the investment strategy: administration of program-related regrants, direct investments, and investment structures to improve operational efficiency and strengthen overall accounting of liquid and non-liquid assets.
    • Strategically support the Managing Director of Impact Investments in the creation of investment vehicles and ongoing fund administration, as well as ensure investment, finance, operations, and data analytics staff operate in coordination with accounting and finance functions.

Compliance, Internal Controls and Risk Management

  • Maintain robust internal financial controls and ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Monitor financial and tax implications of investment holdings and provide guidance on agreements and contracts.
  • Oversee corporate administration, including regulatory compliance, contract reviews, external legal services, recordkeeping, incorporation filings (e.g. Delaware), and regulatory (FINRA/SEC) filings.
  • Oversee team management of IT, annual technology budget, and IT personnel (contractors and/or full time employees as strategy demands).
  • Ensure compliance with employment law and statutory requirements across Village Capital's operating countries, including oversight of GEO/PEO relationships, international payroll, and entity-level employment obligations.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Build and supervise a high-performing finance and fund administration team that can operationalize financial strategy.
  • Build and supervise a high-performing human resources team that can operationalize an adaptable, hybrid organizational strategy.
  • Foster strong internal communication across all teams, with regular updates to departments with work product dependencies and in promotion of a collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Operational and Administrative Oversight

  • Oversee strategy related to banking operations, credit cards, and petty cash to ensure accurate reporting and regulatory compliance.
  • Oversee finance team management of third-party service providers for bookkeeping, controls, accounts payable/receivable, and financial software.
  • Ensure service levels and practices align with VilCap’s needs and industry standards.
  • Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting, tax filings and other finance and administrative-related matters for VilCap legal entities.
  • Coordinate cross-functional policies and processes impacting finance, operations, and grant management.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, record keeping, and alignment with organizational systems.
  • Oversee the procurement and contracting process for the organization’s third-party services and the administration of systems used in finance and administration.

Board and Finance Committee Support

  • Work closely with the CEO and Treasurer of the Board to liaise with the Board of Directors, including serving on and co-leading the Board Finance Committee.
  • Oversee preparing and distribution of meeting materials, financial reports, and dashboards for Quarterly Finance Committee and Board meetings, and lead presentation of financial results during quarterly meetings.

Business model and revenue model

The Managing Director will be responsible, in collaboration with the CEO, for the design, management, and evolution of Village Capital’s business model, and in collaboration with the Business Development team, Village Capital’s revenue diversification strategy. The role will require:

  • Experience designing and implementing business models, including revenue diversification strategies.
  • Fundraising track record and ability to manage complex external stakeholder relationships preferred; experience in raising pre-seed, seed, Series A rounds welcomed.
  • Willingness to ensure design and quality of products/services to find complementary, mutual benefits between Village Capital activities and value creation.
  • Understanding of stakeholder value-creation business models and ability to design and run a multi-stakeholder, systems-change focused operational model.
  • Familiarity with regenerative and sustainable business models and willingness to leverage these principles to Village Capital’s operational and strategic growth.
  • Commitment to community-based decision-making practices and community centered approaches.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field; CPA, CFA, MBA preferred.
  • 7-10+ years of financial management experience, with an understanding of organizations with highly diversified revenue streams and experience with investment management.
  • 2-3 years in a senior managerial role, including experience supervising teams and third-party providers.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
  • Demonstrated ability to build and implement systems that enable efficient finance and grant reporting and seamless integration of operations.
  • Proven understanding of how to collaborate with diverse teams to manage financial systems that streamline processes to support a complex business model.

Skills and Competencies

  • Expertise in accounting, financial planning, and operations management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to build forward-looking financial projections and financial models to deliver strategic financial insights.
  • Proficiency in technology and data management, including financial software.
  • Working knowledge of human resources operations and organizational development, including compensation structures, performance management approaches, and employment compliance.
  • Position on AI use cases (and limitations) as relevant to work outputs and willingness to critically engage with firm-wide AI policy development.
  • Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting financial and operational concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to create and maintain a positive organizational culture through leadership and collaboration.

Compensation & Benefits

This role offers a base salary of $160,000–$185,000 (or the equivalent in local currency), commensurate with skills and experience. We also offer a fully remote work environment, flexible PTO, and stipends to support your growth and well-being — including annual professional development and wellness allowances, a remote work stipend, and monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet. For candidates in the United Kingdom and Kenya, we offer a monthly health allowance. For candidates in the United States, we offer a health benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, as well as a 401(k) with up to a 3% match.

How to Apply

Please include your CV along with a cover letter outlining how your experience aligns with this role and the value it would add to Village Capital.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Village Capital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Salary: $165,000 - $180,000

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP Signavio Architect to lead business process transformation, process architecture, and process optimization initiatives using the SAP Signavio Business Transformation Suite.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, SAP functional teams, and transformation leaders to establish process architecture, identify improvement opportunities, and support SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.

The role requires a strong combination of SAP Signavio expertise, business process management (BPM), process architecture, SAP S/4HANA knowledge, and stakeholder leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the SAP Signavio architecture and implementation approach across enterprise transformation programs.
  • Design the overall business process architecture, including process hierarchy, process taxonomy, standards, governance, and modeling conventions.

    • SAP Signavio Process Intelligence
    • SAP Signavio Process Insights

Business Architecture

Position Summary

Vista Equity Partners (Vista) is a leading global investment firm that invests exclusively in enterprise software, data and technology-enabled companies across private equity, credit, public equity and permanent capital strategies. The firm brings an approach that prioritizes creating enduring market value for the benefit of its global ecosystem of investors, portfolio companies, customers, and employees. Further information is available at vistaequitypartners.com.

Vista Equity Partners is on a fast-paced growth trajectory, with assets under management exceeding $100 billion. As the firm scales its internal operations and technology capabilities, the Business Technology team is seeking a motivated, curious, and AI-forward Business Analyst to support its corporate stakeholder groups. Business Technology serves as the firm’s internal technology enablement function, working to make workflows more efficient, reduce manual effort, improve processes, and maintain a clear understanding of the overall enterprise architecture across the firm. With 300+ applications in daily use, the team plays a critical role in determining technology needs. We evaluate solutions, whether net new vendors or internally built tools, customize their implementation, and drive adoption across the business.This is an individual contributor role with a dedicated support across HR, Finance, the Value Creation Team (VCT), and OneVista. The Business Analyst will work closely with both business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, support system configuration, assist with adoption efforts, and help identify opportunities for process improvement.The ideal candidate is eager to grow at the intersection of technology and business operations. They are naturally drawn to AI tools and bring the organizational discipline and communication skills needed to manage a varied portfolio of work in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

Technology Enablement & Process Improvement

  • Develop familiarity with the technology platforms and workflows used by HR, Finance, VCT, and OneVista, building toward subject-matter expertise over time.
  • Identify, evaluate, and help recommend solutions, whether net new vendors or internally built tools, to address gaps in the firm’s technology stack.
  • Maintain an understanding of Vista’s enterprise application landscape, flagging integration opportunities, redundancies, and deprecation candidates to the team.
  • Coordinate with the broader technology team on cross-platform integrations and data flows to ensure connectivity across systems.
  • Contribute to process improvement efforts across both Business Technology’s internal operations and the workflows of supported stakeholder groups.

AI & Automation

  • Bring an AI-first mindset to daily work, actively leveraging Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT Enterprise, Slackbot, Replit, and other AI development platforms to accelerate delivery and reduce repetitive manual effort.
  • Help build automated workflows and lightweight internal tools that reduce friction for stakeholders and improve team consistency.
  • Identify opportunities to apply intelligent automation across supported business functions, from document processing and reporting to workflow orchestration and data validation.
  • Stay current on the evolving AI tooling landscape and flag relevant capabilities to the team.

Business Analysis & Requirements

  • Gather, document, and help prioritize requirements from stakeholders across HR, Finance, VCT, and OneVista, translating business needs into user stories, process maps, and functional specifications.
  • Maintain well-organized documentation for all initiatives, keeping a reliable record of decisions, configurations, and open items throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support test planning and execution for system changes and new implementations - helping define test cases, coordinate testers, track defects, and assist with UAT to ensure solutions meet business needs before deployment.
  • Track and report on KPIs for supported platforms and workflows, surfacing issues and escalating as appropriate.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build working relationships across Vista’s corporate teams, serving as a reliable point of contact for technology questions, requests, and day-to-day support.
  • Partner with the broader technology team on initiative prioritization, delivery coordination, and operational support.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders on project status, timelines, and upcoming changes, adjusting the level of detail based on the audience.
  • Assist in preparing reporting and materials that summarize project status and technology updates for team leads and firm leadership.
  • Support a portfolio of concurrent projects across varying complexity and timeframes, while staying responsive to ad hoc and urgent needs such as bug fixes, access requests, and time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Actively participate in team meetings, stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Qualifications

Qualifications

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, highly organized, and eager to build expertise at the intersection of business analysis, technology, and operations. They are a fast learner who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and brings an interest in using technology with a focus on AI to solve problems and improve processes. They are comfortable asking questions, navigating ambiguity, and working across teams in a fast-paced environment.

  • One to three years of experience in a business analyst, operations, technology support, or similar role; recent graduates with strong internship or project experience will be considered.
  • Demonstrated AI and automation mindset with hands-on or academic experience using AI-powered tools such as Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT Enterprise, Slackbot, Replit, or similar platforms; a genuine enthusiasm for building with AI and improving workflows is essential.
  • Strong analytical skills, ideally with experience building reports or dashboards in Salesforce, Sigma, Excel, or PowerBI.
  • Exposure to Salesforce or similar CRM platforms is a plus.
  • Solid foundation in requirements gathering and documentation, with the ability to translate conversations into clear written summaries, user stories, or process notes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to adapt tone and detail level for different audiences, from technical teammates to business stakeholders.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously without losing track of priorities or follow-ups.
  • Collaborative, comfortable working across teams, asking for help, and contributing to a group effort.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, information systems, finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Exposure to or interest in private equity, investment management, or professional services is a plus but not required.

Company Overview

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm that exclusively invests in enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled organizations across private equity, permanent capital, credit, and public equity strategies. Vista’s approach prioritizes creating enduring market value for the benefit of its global ecosystem of investors, companies, customers, and employees. Further information is available at vistaequitypartners.com. Follow Vista on LinkedIn, @Vista Equity Partners, and on X, @Vista_Equity.

About Salvo Software

Salvo Software is a global firm that provides cost-effective software solutions to guide enterprises and startups through digital transformation. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled AI Developer with a strong backend and machine learning engineering background to design, train, optimize, and deploy LLM models in on-prem and offline environments. This role is deeply technical and hands-on.

You will work closely with our engineering and product teams to build end-to-end LLM pipelines — including data preprocessing, supervised fine-tuning, model quantization, evaluation, RAG pipeline design, and deployment using local or air-gapped infrastructure. If you enjoy working with cutting-edge open-source LLMs, building context-aware AI systems, and designing reliable backend pipelines, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Core LLM Development

  • Train and fine-tune LLMs using supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
  • Work with open-source models such as LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen, and similar architectures.
  • Build LoRA / Q-LoRA pipelines for efficient fine-tuning.
  • Implement and optimize data preprocessing workflows, including tokenization and long-context handling.
  • Use and extend Hugging Face Transformers & Datasets for training and inference.
  • Parse and process structured and semi-structured data, including XML/XSD files.
  • Implement document parsing solutions for Office formats (python-docx, OpenXML).

RAG & Context-Aware Systems

  • Design and implement end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for document-grounded question answering and knowledge retrieval.
  • Build and maintain vector stores and embedding pipelines using tools such as FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, or pgvector.
  • Optimize retrieval strategies including hybrid search, re-ranking, and chunking approaches tailored for domain-specific corpora.
  • Develop and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integrations to enable LLMs to interact dynamically with tools, APIs, and external data sources.
  • Design agentic workflows that leverage MCP to give models structured access to internal systems and context in a controlled, auditable manner.

Offline / On-Prem Model Expertise

  • Deploy, run, and maintain models fully offline and in air-gapped environments.
  • Perform model optimization and quantization (GGUF, GPTQ, AWQ, bitsandbytes).
  • Build and maintain inference systems using frameworks like vLLM, TGI, and Ollama.
  • Optimize GPU usage (CUDA, cuDNN, VRAM-aware batching).
  • Maintain local CI/CD pipelines for ML models without cloud dependencies.
  • Manage local model registries, versioning, and artifacts.
  • Ensure RAG and MCP components are fully operational in offline and restricted network environments.

Backend & DevOps

  • Build backend services in Python for ML training and inference workflows.
  • Work with relational databases (Postgres/MySQL) and vector databases for RAG storage layers.
  • Use Docker and Git for reliable development and deployment pipelines.
  • Use Azure DevOps for CI/CD, including local runners when applicable.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in Python for backend and machine learning development.
  • Expertise with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, along with scikit-learn and pandas.
  • Solid knowledge of Postgres or MySQL for data storage.
  • Experience with Docker and Git.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM training, fine-tuning, and optimization.
  • Experience with Hugging Face Transformers & Datasets.
  • Familiarity with XML/XSD and Office document parsing tools.
  • Experience deploying models with vLLM, TGI, or Ollama.
  • Understanding of quantization techniques such as GGUF, GPTQ, or AWQ.
  • Experience with GPU optimization and the CUDA stack.
  • Experience building solutions for offline, on-prem, and air-gapped environments.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines, including embedding models, vector stores, and retrieval optimization strategies.
  • Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to connect LLMs with external tools, APIs, and structured data sources.
  • Experience with advanced RAG techniques such as HyDE or multi-hop retrieval.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building agentic systems using MCP in production or near-production environments.
  • Experience managing ML model registries in offline environments.
  • Familiarity with AWS for hybrid deployments.
  • Experience with secure environments, restricted networks, or enterprise compliance requirements.

Soft Skills

  • Experience discussing complex technical topics with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.description:
For People is a team of skilled technologists improving government digital services for disadvantaged and vulnerable populations. We embed directly in government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

Your Impact

As the Technical Delivery Manager on the Medicaid team, you bring clarity where it is missing. The team responds to novel analytic questions using Medicaid data, and this role is about listening across policy, technical, and government partner contexts, making sense of what is actually being asked, and turning that into clear decisions, shared expectations, and workable next steps.

As Technical Delivery Manager, you will build trust by identifying tradeoffs early, clarifying decision rights, and following through. This role holds both delivery responsibility for the Medicaid project while lending product skills as well: you work with strong project SMEs to document and support what gets built and when, and you make sure the team has the clarity, coordination, and tools needed to build it well.

The team builds reports for CMS audiences, produced through a data pipeline that draws on national Medicaid data (e.g. T-MSIS). The data science team builds and runs that pipeline in Python and SQL. A policy and program SME provides Medicaid expertise and supports stakeholder relationships. You will not write code or be expected to understand dense policy documents, but you will work close enough to the team to scope work, set priorities, ask the right questions, and represent the work well to stakeholders.

Our Culture

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means it is okay to run out during the day and pick a child up from school or go for a mid-day walk if it is nice outside.

This position is 100% remote. Our entire team is also entirely remote across the United States, from the west coast to the east coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none.

This position's published base salary range is between $100,000 and $130,000 annually, plus generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

Occasional paid travel may be required for on-site collaboration with government partners.

Your Opportunities

On this project, you will:

  • Facilitate problem framing exercises, gather assumptions, and explore options for ad-hoc requests, such as valid value changes, data quality enhancements, and one-off analyses
  • Own the product roadmap: create it with stakeholder input, keep it current and accurate, and run the roadmap reviews that keep partners aligned
  • Translate jargon-heavy policy or technical inputs into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and decision memos, then scope and prioritize that work with the data science and data engineering team
  • Build enough working fluency in the team's data and build process to shape and scope requirements the data science team can act on
  • Maintain a shared understanding of delivery expectations across partner teams, reducing communication and handoff gaps without micromanaging
  • Own the risk register in consultation with the team's policy lead, documenting decision points and tradeoffs around complexity, level of effort, and feasibility
  • Own reporting readiness and delivery for the monthly reports: make sure the clearance process runs predictably and hold sign-off on each report's delivery
  • Prepare and deliver leadership-ready summaries that translate complex work into understandable, defensible narratives

You Bring

  • A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People's values: passion, fun, curiosity, sustainability, humility, and respect
  • 4 to 5 years of experience in delivery, product management, or discovery roles on technical or data-heavy programs
  • Experience owning product priorities or a roadmap, including saying no and explaining why
  • Familiarity with agile delivery practices and the ability to support planning ceremonies
  • Comfort reading and reasoning about data pipeline work in Python and SQL, enough to scope it, prioritize it, and translate it into plain-language summaries
  • Government experience. State or federal health agency experience preferred
  • Comfort working with high-profile government partners and high-stakes, high-visibility programs
  • Comfort switching between the big picture and the details
  • Strong synthesis and written communication, for example requirements, decision memos, risk summaries, and leadership briefings
  • The ability to operate in ambiguous situations, acting on the question of where the team needs clarity and how to get there
  • Awareness of government pace: the ability to over-communicate, anticipate and proactively address roadblocks, document, and follow through
  • Comfort working in partnership with a strong leadership team, navigating overlaps and gaps in responsibilities

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Experience with CMS or other federal health agency programs and systems
  • Familiarity with Medicaid data or other large-scale health data
  • Experience navigating stakeholder approval and formal clearance pathways

Some fine print: You will be working on a federal government engagement, which carries a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. You must perform all work physically within the United States at all times. In addition, you must be a United States citizen and be able to pass a public trust background check.

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Tax Manager is responsible for leading tax planning, compliance, and advisory services for high-net-worth individuals, families, trusts, estates, private foundations, and closely held businesses. This role partners closely with wealth advisors to develop strategic tax solutions, reviews complex tax returns, manages client engagements, and provides technical guidance on sophisticated tax matters. The Senior Tax Manager also mentors tax professionals, fosters strong client relationships, and stays current on tax law developments to deliver proactive planning and exceptional client service.

Job Description:

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead tax planning, compliance, and advisory services for high-net-worth individuals, families, trusts, estates, private foundations, closely held businesses, and related entities, including extensions, quarterly estimates, projections, and year-end planning;

  • Review complex federal, state, and local tax returns for accuracy, technical quality, planning opportunities, and compliance with applicable filing requirements;

  • Serve as a tax resource to wealth advisors by identifying tax planning opportunities that align with clients financial, estate, charitable, and investment objectives;

  • Research and analyze complex tax issues, prepare clear recommendations, and communicate technical conclusions to clients, advisors, and internal stakeholders;

  • Manage client engagements from planning through delivery, including workflow, deadlines, review processes, prioritization, and coordination with permanent and seasonal tax staff;

  • Build and maintain trusted client relationships by providing proactive communication, high-quality service, and timely responses to client and advisor inquiries;

  • Collaborate with wealth management teams to integrate strategic income tax, estate and gift tax, charitable giving, stock option, multi-state and retirement planning considerations into client recommendations.

  • Supervise, mentor, train, and review the work of tax professionals, including providing feedback, technical guidance, and support during busy season;

  • Assist Tax Leadership with developing internal tax education, process improvements, and practice standards that support consistent, high-quality client service;

  • Monitor relevant tax law developments and assist with communicating timely planning insights to advisors and clients through newsletters, presentations, social media, and other client communications.

Qualifications

  • CPA, EA, JD, or comparable advanced tax credential, with a minimum of 8+ years of relevant tax experience; public accounting, family office, or wealth management experience strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated expertise serving high-net-worth and ultra-high net-worth individuals and families, with significant experience reviewing individual, fiduciary, gift, foundation, partnership, and closely held business tax returns.

  • Strong technical knowledge of federal and state income tax, fiduciary income tax, gift and estate tax concepts, charitable planning, stock compensation, and multi-state compliance matters.

  • Proven ability to lead engagements, manage competing deadlines, supervise staff, and maintain ownership of client deliverables through completion.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex tax concepts into clear, practical recommendations for clients and advisors.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, and demonstrated ability to learn and leverage tax, planning, workflow, and document management technology.

  • Advanced experience with high-net-worth individual, trust, estate, gift, private foundation, partnership, S corporation, and closely held business tax matters preferred.

  • Experience with estate and wealth transfer planning, charitable giving strategies, stock option planning, tax notices, and tax controversy support preferred.

  • Experience with ProSystem fx® Tax, CCH Axcess, BNA Income Tax™ Planner, tax research platforms, and workflow or document management tools preferred.

Description/Responsibilities

Our Senior B2B Content Writer partners day-to-day with B2B Marketing strategists to turn strategy into high-performing content across the buyer journey. This is an embedded role: you’ll participate in campaign working sessions, help shape positioning and messaging, and translate complex topics into clear, credible, persuasive content for B2B decision-makers.

At a glance:

  • Co-own B2B content planning with strategists – including the VP of B2B Marketing and the VP of Growth Operations - across demand gen, ABM, sales enablement, and customer marketing
  • Write and optimize core assets: landing pages, emails, case studies, one-pagers/solution briefs, blog posts, webinar/event copy, and enablement materials
  • Interview subject matter experts, synthesize research, and ensure accuracy/claim substantiation
  • Use performance and sales feedback to continuously improve messaging, clarity, and conversion

As a full-time, integrated member of the team, you’ll engage internal experts, translate complex topics into audience-ready narratives, and drive continuous improvement in B2B content quality, consistency, and delivery.

Reporting & Team:

  • Reports to: Marketing Content Leader
  • Works closely with: Leadership for Content Marketing, B2B Marketing, Growth Operations, Sales and Client Relations, as well as subject matter experts across the organization
  • To support production excellence, participates in weekly content planning, campaign kickoffs, copy and design reviews, and retrospectives to improve quality, speed, and performance

Essential Job Functions:

  • Translate campaign strategy, segment insights, and product positioning into audience-ready messaging and content in partnership with B2B Marketing strategists
  • Write, edit, and iterate a range of B2B assets (e.g., landing pages, emails, sales collateral, case studies, one-pagers, solution briefs, blog posts, webinar/event copy, talking points, and internal enablement content)
  • Build content from credible source material: interview SMEs, synthesize research, and ensure terminology and claims are accurate and appropriately substantiated
  • Develop strategic narratives and proof points: propose angles, identify content gaps, and recommend formats that align to funnel stage and channel
  • Shape, maintain and evolve B2B voice, content, and messaging guidelines across products and audiences in partnership with brand, product marketing, and strategy
  • Use performance insights (engagement, conversion, qualitative sales feedback) to refine messaging, improve clarity, and strengthen content effectiveness over time
  • Coordinate with design, digital, and demand teams to adapt content for channel needs (web, email, paid/organic social, events) and apply best practices (SEO, accessibility, readability)
  • Own drafts through review cycles, incorporate feedback, and ensure content meets brand standards and (where applicable) regulatory/legal requirements

Capabilities:

  • Proven ability to write for B2B audiences, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling messaging and narratives
  • Strong interviewing and synthesis skills: able to elicit insights from SMEs and turn them into accurate, audience-ready content
  • Comfortable operating as an embedded partner in a strategist-led workflow: contributes ideas, flags risks/gaps, and iterates quickly based on feedback
  • Strong editorial judgment and attention to detail (structure, scannability, tone, grammar), with a bias toward clarity and audience outcomes
  • Able to manage work in a shared workflow (briefs, reviews, versioning) and keep stakeholders aligned on status, feedback, and deadlines

Work Style Attributes:

  • Customer- and market-aware: learns the subject matter well enough to write to real buyer needs, objections, and decision criteria
  • Highly collaborative: builds strong working relationships with strategists, product marketers, sales partners, and creative teams
  • Constructive, iterative mindset: welcomes feedback and uses it to strengthen clarity, tone, and performance

Success Metrics:

  • On-time delivery and throughput of priority B2B assets (meets planning commitments for internal and external needs; communicates risks early)
  • High content quality and consistency (voice, accuracy, clarity) evidenced by stakeholder feedback, few revision rounds, and smooth approval processes
  • Campaign and asset performance tied to content (engagement, conversion, influenced pipeline) in partnership with strategists and channel owners
  • Adoption and usability of sales enablement assets (sales feedback, usage signals, and field readiness)

Qualifications

  • 5 - 8+ years of experience writing B2B content in a marketing, agency, editorial, or in-house environment; experience in healthcare, benefits, wellness, or HR/total rewards is strongly preferred
  • Portfolio or writing samples demonstrating B2B content across channels (web, email, enablement, long-form) beneficial
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field preferred
  • Experience writing in regulated or compliance-reviewed environments (e.g., healthcare, benefits, financial services) and comfort navigating reviews and substantiation
  • Strong editorial, writing, and storytelling skills with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences and platforms
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate content development while maintaining accuracy, brand voice, and compliance, and/or to manage content across multiple channels, including social medial, web, email and print, for cataloguing, review and optimization
  • Familiarity with SEO best practices, web writing, and content optimization; able to write for both humans and search intent without sacrificing clarity
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and collaborate with various teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience writing in regulated or compliance-reviewed environments (e.g., healthcare, benefits, financial services) and comfort navigating reviews and substantiation.

À titre d’exemples, ces outils peuvent inclure des flux de travail automatisés, des recommandations fondées sur les données, des outils de rédaction ou de synthèse, ou encore des outils d’interaction avec les candidats ou les employés, selon les responsabilités du poste.

Cette opportunité correspond à un poste vacant existant visant à soutenir les opérations actuelles de l’entreprise.

Résumé du poste

L’administrateur(trice) de bureau en soins virtuels fournit un soutien administratif essentiel afin d’assurer la prestation efficace des services de soins virtuels au sein des services de télésanté Virtual Care. Une fonction clé de ce poste consiste à gérer sur le plan administratif les demandes d’aiguillage sortantes et les résultats de laboratoire médical entrants — y compris leur réception, leur acheminement, leur suivi et leur escalade en temps opportun vers le/la clinicien(ne) autorisé(e) approprié(e) pour examen et mesures à prendre — conformément aux procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) établies. Ce poste n’inclut pas l’interprétation clinique des résultats de laboratoire. Le poste soutient également la planification des horaires des clinicien(ne)s et des patient(e)s, maintient une documentation et des bases de données exactes, soutient les processus de rapprochement de facturation, surveille les exigences de conformité et contribue à la production de rapports ainsi qu’aux opérations du programme. Cette personne travaille en collaboration avec les équipes cliniques et opérationnelles et doit être disponible l’après-midi et en soirée, y compris les fins de semaine, afin d’assurer la continuité du programme.

Exigence de disponibilité : Ce poste est prévu pour assurer une couverture l’après-midi et en soirée, du lundi au dimanche, de 12 h 00 à 20 h 00 (HNA), y compris les fins de semaine et les jours fériés, conformément aux heures d’exploitation du programme.

Responsabilités principales au travail

  • Recevoir, consigner et suivre les résultats de laboratoire médical entrants dans le dossier médical électronique (DME) et les outils de suivi connexes, conformément aux PON établies.

  • Effectuer le tri des résultats de laboratoire entrants en appliquant des critères établis, non interprétatifs, afin de déterminer le niveau d’urgence (p. ex., normal, anormal, critique) et acheminer rapidement les résultats vers le/la clinicien(ne) autorisé(e) approprié(e) pour examen.

  • Faire escalader immédiatement les résultats critiques ou signalés au/à la clinicien(ne) désigné(e) de garde, en suivant les voies d’escalade définies.

  • Surveiller les résultats de laboratoire en attente et en suspens afin qu’aucun résultat ne demeure sans suivi, et signaler à l’équipe clinique les suivis en retard.

  • Maintenir une documentation exacte de toutes les réceptions de résultats, des actions d’acheminement et des confirmations de réception par les clinicien(ne)s.

  • Soutenir l’infirmier(ère) praticien(ne) (IP) responsable clinique afin de veiller à ce que les flux de travail liés aux résultats de laboratoire demeurent conformes aux PON du programme et aux normes de sécurité des patient(e)s.

  • Surveiller l’état des demandes d’aiguillage et des listes d’attente; communiquer avec les cabinets de spécialistes pour vérifier l’avancement des demandes; effectuer le suivi des demandes refusées ou incomplètes; et faire escalader les enjeux à l’IP responsable, au besoin.

  • Examiner et rapprocher les consultations de soins virtuels afin d’assurer l’exactitude de la documentation, l’intégrité de la facturation et la résolution rapide de toute divergence.

  • Agir comme ressource pour les activités d’intégration du personnel et soutenir une communication efficace entre les équipes cliniques et les équipes de soutien, au besoin.

  • Produire des rapports de routine et ponctuels (ad hoc) et contribuer au bon déroulement des opérations quotidiennes.

  • Coordonner les réunions internes, préparer les ordres du jour et consigner les procès-verbaux, au besoin.

  • Soutenir les mises à jour des systèmes, les tests et le déploiement de nouvelles technologies ou de nouveaux flux de travail en soins virtuels.

  • Respecter l’ensemble des politiques en matière d’éthique, de conformité et de sécurité de l’information.

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We're hiring a Nurse Practitioner to serve as the primary clinical point of contact for patients navigating their remote care journey.

In this role, you will lead clinical decision-making with a strong emphasis on guideline-directed medical therapy for heart failure, as well as adherence to evidence-based guidelines for type 2 diabetes and hypertension, including proactive and asynchronous medication titration based on patient vitals, symptoms, and trends. You will oversee patients, manage clinical escalations, and collaborate closely with the patient’s physician or provider to optimize treatment plans, adjust medications, and determine the appropriate level of care. This role requires a high level of clinical autonomy, strong judgment, and close collaboration with Registered Nurses and Patient Success teams to deliver timely, patient-centered, and scalable remote care.

Although this position is fully remote, it is a highly collaborative, fast-paced clinical role with clear expectations for productivity, responsiveness, and quality.

Licensure Requirements

Licenses must be active and in good standing at time of hire.

Schedule Requirements

  • Initiate and titrate guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) while collaborating closely with physicians, RNs, and care teams to optimize outcomes.

jobs.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Senior Manager, Sales - Account Management (Existing Customer Expansion), joining our Global Expansion team within the Go-To-Market (GTM) organization.

You'll lead a high-performing team of Senior Account Managers responsible for growing and retaining our Mid-Market and Enterprise customer base across EMEA. You'll own the daily operating rhythm of the business—forecasting, coaching, deal strategy, and execution—while creating an environment where people are challenged, supported, and inspired to do their best work.

Success in this role requires more than commercial excellence. We're looking for a leader who develops people, builds strong cross-functional partnerships, and creates momentum during periods of change. You recognize problems quickly—but more importantly, you help teams solve them.

What you bring

Commercial Leadership

  • Strong experience in Account Management or Existing Business leadership, ideally within Mid-Market and Enterprise segments.
  • Experience leading quota-carrying sales teams with responsibility for forecasting, pipeline management, performance coaching, and revenue attainment.
  • Proven ability to develop high-performing Account Managers through coaching, feedback, and structured development.
  • Comfortable operating as a hands-on leader—jumping into strategic customer conversations, negotiations, and deal coaching when needed.
  • Strong forecasting discipline with the ability to identify risks, opportunities, and trends early through data.
  • Experience defining, measuring, and presenting sales metrics and business performance to senior leadership.
  • Proven track record of driving pipeline rigor, operational excellence, and predictable revenue outcomes.
  • Experience with Salesforce and modern sales technology.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • A genuine coaching mindset with a passion for helping others grow and succeed.
  • Builds trust quickly and develops strong partnerships across Product, RevOps, Customer Success, Acquisition Sales, Marketing, Finance, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading confidently through change, helping others stay focused on execution rather than uncertainty.
  • Naturally optimistic and solutions-oriented. You raise risks thoughtfully, challenge ideas constructively, and instinctively pair problems with practical solutions.
  • Creates positive energy within teams. You elevate the people around you through collaboration, accountability, and encouragement.
  • Takes ownership beyond your immediate team, proactively identifying opportunities to improve how the broader organization operates.
  • Celebrates team success over individual recognition and contributes positively to the broader leadership team.
  • Consistently delivers strong business outcomes while building a healthy, sustainable, and high-performing team culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the daily operating rhythm of the Account Management team through effective pipeline reviews, forecast calls, one-on-ones, deal coaching, and performance management.
  • Meet and exceed team revenue goals while developing a high-performing organization capable of sustained success.
  • Coach and empower Senior Account Managers to maximize customer value, improve commercial execution, and grow in their careers.
  • Stay close to the business by supporting strategic negotiations, joining key customer conversations, and helping remove obstacles that accelerate deals.
  • Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement where high standards and strong support coexist.
  • Foster a solutions-first mindset by helping the team confront difficult challenges honestly, identify practical paths forward, and execute with urgency.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes across the broader Existing Business organization.
  • Build trusted partnerships with Product, RevOps, Customer Success, Finance, Marketing, and Acquisition Sales to improve customer experience and business performance.
  • Ensure consistent forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene, account prioritization, and sales execution across the team.
  • Regularly analyze business performance to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights for senior leadership.
  • Provide weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on pipeline health, forecast accuracy, customer expansion, wins, losses, and business performance.
  • Develop a team culture where collaboration, curiosity, resilience, and continuous learning are expected and celebrated.
  • Act as a role model for Remote's values by creating alignment, building trust, and helping the broader organization succeed—not just your own team.

Practical

  • Reporting to: VP, Expansion Revenue (interim, pending broader Existing Business organizational changes)
  • Team: Global Expansion
  • Region: EMEA
  • Location: Remote
  • Start Date: As soon as possible
  • Level: M4

Pay Transparency

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The On-Target Earnings for this position is between $180,050 - $270,100 USD. The base salary is 60%.

Application Process

  1. (Async) Profile Review
  2. Recruiter Interview
  3. Hiring Manager Interview
  4. Peer Leadership Interview
  5. VP 2nd Interview
  6. Bar Raiser Interview
  7. Prior employment verification check

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

CRM Integration Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: CRM Integration Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a CRM Integration Architect to design and govern integrations between Salesforce and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on integration architecture, middleware selection, API strategy, and event-driven patterns that connect Salesforce reliably with ERP, data, marketing, and operational systems. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce integration solutions at meaningful scale and brings deep familiarity with both Salesforce-native and enterprise middleware approaches. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the end-to-end integration architecture for Salesforce ecosystems spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, and Industry Clouds.
  • Select and apply appropriate integration patterns including request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, and event-driven approaches.
  • Design integrations using Salesforce-native capabilities (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Connect, Composite APIs) alongside enterprise middleware such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Lead integration design reviews and approve technical designs across Salesforce programs.
  • Define API strategy, contract management, and versioning standards for Salesforce-related integrations.
  • Architect data synchronization patterns for high-volume integrations with ERP, billing, and operational systems.
  • Design identity and access patterns for Salesforce integrations including OAuth flows and connected app management.
  • Establish error handling, retry, and dead-letter strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Drive performance, scalability, and governor-limit management for integration-heavy Salesforce implementations, designing patterns that stay safely within platform limits even as transaction volumes grow over time.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure integrations meet enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Collaborate closely with vendors to evaluate and onboard integration platforms, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Stay current with Salesforce integration capabilities and broader iPaaS evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time on complex integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and enterprise application architecture.
  • Experience designing data synchronization strategies with ERP and operational systems.
  • Strong understanding of identity, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect credential.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce integration programs.
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect.
  • Experience with event-driven integration platforms (Kafka, Solace, Confluent).
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds and their data-integration nuances.
  • Exposure to high-volume integration scenarios (10M+ records/day).
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.
How to Apply

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Windchill Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.


Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Windchill Integration Developer to design, build, and operate integrations connecting PTC Windchill with ERP, MES, CAD, and other engineering and manufacturing systems. In this role you will own the technical integration layer between Windchill and the broader enterprise systems landscape. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on Windchill integration experience and a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, middleware platforms, and PLM-to-ERP data flows. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integrations between Windchill and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Oracle Cloud) using Info*Engine, web services, and middleware platforms.
  • Build CAD integrations for Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Catia, and NX with Windchill, including check-in/check-out workflows and metadata mapping.
  • Develop integrations between Windchill and MES, MOM, and quality systems.
  • Build REST and SOAP services for Windchill data using OData, Info*Engine, or custom Java services.
  • Implement message-based and event-driven integrations using middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, SAP CPI).
  • Design and operate robust error-handling, alerting, and resubmission patterns, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Profile and optimize performance of high-volume integrations, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations and replace them with modern, middleware-mediated patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Collaborate with PLM, ERP, and CAD functional teams to align integrations with business processes.
  • Develop integration documentation, message specifications, and runbooks, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging integration tools and patterns, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PLM integration experience with a strong focus on Windchill.
  • Hands-on experience with Info*Engine and Windchill Java API.
  • Experience designing PLM-to-ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle).
  • Working knowledge of CAD integration patterns.
  • Experience with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, or SAP CPI.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Windchill data model.
  • Experience with REST and SOAP web services.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PTC Windchill certifications.
  • Experience with ThingWorx or IIoT integration.
  • Exposure to API management platforms.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and Kafka-based integration patterns.
  • Experience operating Windchill in the cloud.
